subject: Rollforward go-live ops coordination — final scheduling and fallback owners
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acme.com>; Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@datashield.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Rollforward go-live ops coordination — proposed final call windows

Hi Lena / Samir,

Hope youre well. We're aiming to lock the final go-live orchestration call this week so we can confirm owners, fallback/rollback responsibilities, and the post-cutover validation checklist. Proposed agenda (30-45m):
- Quick rollout timeline & owners (AE/SE/customer ops)
- Network/infra checklist and whitelist confirmation
- Fallback/rollback triggers and owners + SLA impacts
- Smoke tests & production validation plan
- Logistics: hotline, escalation roster, and post-mortem schedule

Available slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-09-01 09:30–10:15
- Tue 2026-09-01 15:00–15:45
- Wed 2026-09-02 08:00–08:45

I've attached the latest go-live checklist and the network whitelist template for your infra team. Can you confirm which participants will join from your side (engineers, procurement, security)? If none of those slots work, propose two alternatives and we'll accommodate.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (will send calendar invite once we confirm)
Confluence: https://docs.redwood.com/confluence/display/ACME/Go-Live-Runbook
Attachments: redwood-go-live-checklist-v3.pdf (2.1 MB), network-whitelist-template.csv

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0183

From: Lena Park <lena.park@acme.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@datashield.io>, procurement@acme.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollforward go-live ops coordination — proposed final call windows

Thanks, Sergio. Appreciate the clear agenda and the checklist.

My infra engineers (Ill have Rahul and Mei on the call) are available for Tue 2026-09-01 15:00–15:45 PDT. Procurement (copied) cannot do the morning slot — theyre in meetings all day Tuesday. Security wants a brief pre-call with Marissa if possible (15-20m) to review the data flows, but they can join the main call for the fallback bits.

If we lock Tue 15:00, can Marissa do a 14:20–14:40 pre-call with our security contacts to go over the data handling and logging? Also, pls confirm whether the network whitelist will be applied by your infra team or ours (well need the CSV enough lead time).

Lena Park
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Acme Financials
lena.park@acme.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acme.com>; Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@datashield.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollforward go-live ops coordination — confirmed time + pre-call

Perfect — locking Tue 2026-09-01 15:00–15:45 PDT.

Actions Im taking now:
- Sending calendar invite with Zoom link to all participants (will include Rahul, Mei, Samir, procurement).
- Marissa: can you confirm availability for the security pre-call Tue 14:20–14:40? If yes, please join and well add the security attendees.
- Aditya: please prepare a short run-through of the rollback script and the KV cache invalidation steps well perform if we need to roll back.
- Procurement (Samir/procurement@acme.com): please confirm who will sign off on the final SOW; if you need a copy of the final MSA redline, I can attach.
- Network whitelist: Lena, well apply the whitelist on our side once you confirm the final IPs in the attached CSV. If youd prefer to manage it, tell us and well hand over the CSV.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=VIEW&eid=abcd1234
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210
Confluence (runbook): https://docs.redwood.com/confluence/display/ACME/Go-Live-Runbook
Attachments referenced: redwood-go-live-checklist-v3.pdf, network-whitelist-template.csv

Thanks all — see you Tue.

Sergio

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Lena Park <lena.park@acme.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@datashield.io>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rollforward go-live ops coordination — confirmed time + pre-call

Adding a couple of operational notes from a leadership perspective:
- Fallback/rollback owner: Marissa, please take primary ownership for the rollback procedure and post-cutover validation. Aditya will be your technical lead for any runtime ops (KV cache flush, model switch).
- Hotline & escalation: Ill be on standby and will coordinate escalation to platform infra if we cross the SLA threshold requiring credit discussion.
- Pre-call: Marissa, please cover the security checklist with Lenas team (14:20–14:40) and call out any open items in Confluence so procurement has what they need for sign-off.
- Post-call follow-up: we expect a short incident playbook (one pager) to be posted in Confluence within 24 hours of go-live. That will be part of the final acceptance criteria.

If procurement needs anything from leadership to accelerate sign-off, loop me in and Ill assist.

Soojin Lee
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
